overview.platforms: MT5, Bybit API, Web Trading Platform
overview.description: Dolvero is a premier multi-asset prop trading firm providing simulated capital across Forex CFDs, external Crypto liquidity via Bybit, and Perpetual contracts with up to 90% profit splits, zero time limits, and static drawdowns.

rules.consistency_rule: Crypto and Perpetual accounts have a 40% consistency rule (no single day can account for more than 40% of total profit). Forex accounts have no consistency rule.
rules.firm_rules_content:
• News Trading: Standard Forex accounts restrict opening positions 10 minutes before and after high-impact red folder news unless News Add-on is active. Holding open trades through news is permitted. Crypto and Perps tracks are exempt from news trading restrictions.
• Drawdown: Maximum daily loss of 5% based on balance or equity at end-of-day. Maximum overall trailing drawdown of 10% (Static).
• Weekend & Overnight: Weekend and overnight holding allowed across all models.
• EA & Algo Trading: Algorithmic trading and automated bots are permitted.
• Prohibited Strategies: High-frequency trading, reverse trading, account hedging across multiple accounts, grid trading, and martingale.
